scope: Owner clarification about automatic summary quality; no political research or forecast change.
changes: Require substantive reassessment on both daily and weekly runs, even for holds.
Require material-development dispositions, every-issue coverage, actual summary-change rationale and dated-assumption review in each run.
Require a weekly competing-interpretation challenge; reject timestamp-only freshness.
Treat post-midterm wording as a current example, never a permanent narrative template.
limits: Structural checks enforce review coverage and traceability; they cannot certify analytical truth or exhaustive reporting. Gaps must be explicit.
